name: Town & Country Village
summary: Town & Country Village is West Houston's premier upscale lifestyle center featuring over 90 retailers, restaurants, and service merchants in a beautifully landscaped open-air setting. Located at Memorial Drive and Beltway 8, this one-stop destination offers everything from boutique shopping and fine dining to banking, healthcare, and spa services with convenient storefront parking.
demographics: Town & Country Village attracts an affluent, upscale demographic primarily consisting of middle to upper-income households from West Houston's Memorial area. The typical visitor profile includes professionals aged 35-65 with household incomes exceeding $100,000, along with families seeking quality retail, dining, and service options. The trade area encompasses some of Houston's most desirable neighborhoods, drawing shoppers who value convenience, quality, and a curated mix of mainstream and boutique retailers. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for one-stop convenience combined with upscale amenities, with visitors frequently combining errands with leisure activities like dining al fresco in the garden-scaped patios.
description: Town & Country Village stands as West Houston's premier upscale shopping destination, strategically located at 12850 Memorial Drive in the northeast quadrant of Memorial Drive and Beltway 8. This distinguished lifestyle center features more than 90 retailers, restaurants, and service merchants thoughtfully arranged in an open-air setting enhanced by lush garden-scaped patios, fountains, and the inviting Grand Plaza Park. The center offers an exceptional blend of mainstream brands, stylish boutiques, fine dining restaurants, and casual eateries, complemented by comprehensive lifestyle services including banking, healthcare, beauty and spa services, and fitness studios. Anchored by a Randalls Flagship Grocery Store, Barnes & Noble, and Walgreens, Town & Country Village provides the ultimate one-stop shopping experience with easy storefront parking. The center's upscale atmosphere and diverse tenant mix make it the go-to destination for West Houston residents seeking quality shopping, dining, and services all in one convenient location.
